title: Fresh Install Failing on a Langchain Module
body:
Hi there, first time user, so apologies if I'm just being dumb and didn't understand the instructions...

However, this is the issue I'm seeing when I try to run gpt-engineer:
```ImportError: cannot import name 'get_openai_token_cost_for_model' from 'langchain.callbacks.openai_info'```

I have tried uninstalling and reinstalling langchain. The environment variable for my openai api key is set. Sorry again for confusion, just need some guidance if someone can advise.

linked_prs.title: fix: workaround for refactor on new versions of langchain
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/gpt_engineer/core/token_usage.py b/gpt_engineer/core/token_usage.py
index d3d0de3..bf36ee0 100644
--- a/gpt_engineer/core/token_usage.py
+++ b/gpt_engineer/core/token_usage.py
@@ -5,9 +5,20 @@ from typing import List, Union
 
 import tiktoken
 
-from langchain.callbacks.openai_info import get_openai_token_cost_for_model
 from langchain.schema import AIMessage, HumanMessage, SystemMessage
 
+# workaround for function moved in:
+# https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/blob/535db72607c4ae308566ede4af65295967bb33a8/libs/community/langchain_community/callbacks/openai_info.py
+try:
+    from langchain.callbacks.openai_info import (
+        get_openai_token_cost_for_model,  # fmt: skip
+    )
+except ImportError:
+    from langchain_community.callbacks.openai_info import (
+        get_openai_token_cost_for_model,  # fmt: skip
+    )
+
+
 Message = Union[AIMessage, HumanMessage, SystemMessage]
 
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
